purpose: Photographic skin and nails for the interactive manicure/pedicure game. Nail overlays and preparation zones are implemented separately in SVG/canvas.

assets.prompt: Use case: sketch-to-render. Asset: photorealistic background for an interactive manicure simulator, 4:3 landscape composition. Edit target: the supplied illustrated hand image. Replace its cartoon rendering with a genuine close-range professional salon photograph. Preserve the exact top-down composition and hand pose: one adult woman's LEFT hand, back of hand facing the camera, wrist entering bottom center, four fingers pointing upward and naturally slightly separated, little finger at left, thumb angled upper-right, all FIVE nails fully visible and unobstructed. Keep fingertip and cuticle placement as close to the reference as possible so interactive nail overlays can be aligned. The hand should occupy the same frame area as the reference. Real human anatomy, realistic proportions, natural light warm skin, visible fine pores, tiny skin creases at joints, subtle veins and very fine hairs, authentic soft cuticle folds and nail sidewalls. All five nails must be completely BARE natural translucent pale pink, unpolished, realistic nail beds, short fine ivory free edges, no artificial extensions and no glossy nail polish. The hand rests naturally on a real off-white fine-grained leather manicure cushion on a light natural wood tabletop. Small open black pot of nude manicure gel and a professional brush remain in the upper-left background as in reference, realistic photographed objects. Soft neutral diffused studio light, accurate skin color, sharply resolved skin and all five nails, professional macro beauty photography. Keep the entire photograph consistently photorealistic, not a painted render. No person beyond this hand, no text, logos, numbers, UI, watermark, jewelry, blood, wounds, exaggerated or fused fingers, waxy plastic skin, beauty smoothing, cartoon outlines, vector shading, illustration, or 3D game look.

Use case: sketch-to-render. Asset: photorealistic pedicure simulator background, landscape 4:3. Edit target: supplied illustrated foot scene. Transform the image into a real professional close-up salon photograph, preserving its exact top-down framing, foot pose, proportions and locations of all five toenails as closely as possible. One adult woman's LEFT foot, dorsum facing camera, ankle enters the bottom center, all FIVE toes fully visible, small toe on left and big toe on right. The foot fills the same central area of frame, resting on an off-white fine-grained leather pedicure cushion. Keep the background's light wood floor, out-of-focus plant at left and small black salon trolley at upper-right as photographed real objects. Realistic healthy warm light skin with pores, fine creases and tiny hairs, visible tendon shapes, natural color variation, no airbrushing. All toenails completely BARE and clean, natural translucent pink nail beds with a very thin pale ivory free edge, authentic cuticle folds and sidewalls, rounded square big toenail; NO colored polish, NO fake extensions. Professional natural macro beauty photography with soft neutral diffused light; sharp focus on the skin, cuticles and all five toenails, natural soft contact shadows. Keep anatomy natural, not exaggerated. Avoid cartoon outlines, illustration, painted shading, 3D plastic rendering, waxy glossy skin, extra/missing/fused toes, text, UI, logos, jewelry, blood or injury. Exact composition lock: retain the foot and nail positions from the input so interactive nail overlays can be registered.
